pages.text: In 1975 Colella, Overhauser and Werner split single neutrons with a perfect silicon crystal and joined them again - and tilted the whole thing. One path ran a few centimetres higher than the other; gravity slowed the neutron on it; the two waves came back out of step. Gravity, acting on a quantum wave: $(thing)Δφ = 2πm²gλA·sin α/h²$().

Grow a $(item)Silicon Boule$() (fused silica and coal in the Crystal Growth Furnace), study it for its Laue Pattern, and cut two into a $(item)Perfect Crystal Interferometer$() - three blades still joined at the base, their lattices aligned to a fraction of an atom.

The $(item)Neutron Interferometer$() runs on a radium-beryllium source. Choose the wavelength and tilt it until gravity has turned the phase at least 30 radians and lands it on a bright fringe; count until the phase is known to 0.1 rad. Each record is a great deal of Insight.
